title: Acyclicity of the sealing gates
statement: Let $u,N,o$ be natural numbers with $u<N$ and $o<N$. The three gates consisting, in order, of a NOT gate reading $u$, an OR gate reading $u$ and $N$, and an AND gate reading $o$ and $N+1$ form an acyclic gate list relative to $N$: gate $i$ reads only vertices with indices less than $N+i$.
